analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -3.5% decline pushed RSI to 42.4, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 8.4605 to -7.2876, forming a death cross. 5-day low ($330.99) is similar to 20-day low ($330.99), confirming a Lower High pattern. ADX at 16.5 indicates a non-trending phase with potential for shock-like volatility.
